title: Inpatient Cost-Share Basis Applied to TRICARE Select Stays Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance
content:
**Adjudication rule.** Under the **TRICARE Select** tier's inpatient basis for the facility's network relationship on the admission date, the beneficiary liability on a reprocessed stay with a covered day is figured as follows: where the basis is lesser of per diem or percent, it is the lesser of the daily charge times the covered days and the stated percent of the amount cost-shared; where it is per diem with minimum, it is the daily charge times the covered days but never less than the tier's network minimum charge; where it is percent of allowed, it is the stated percent of the amount cost-shared; otherwise, under per admission copayment, it is the tier's network admission copayment once; each figure is rounded to the cent. A reprocessed stay with no covered day carries no beneficiary liability.

A facility in the network on the admission date takes the network basis and figures; any other facility the non-network ones. The minimum charge is the network minimum charge in either case.

## Tier figures

| Tier | Network: basis; daily charge; minimum; admission copayment; percent | Non-network: basis; daily charge; percent |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | per diem with minimum; 21.15; 25.00; 0.00; 0 | per diem with minimum; 21.15; 0 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | per diem with minimum; 21.15; 25.00; 0.00; 0 | per diem with minimum; 21.15; 0 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | per admission copayment; 0.00; 0.00; 76.00; 0 | percent of allowed; 0.00; 20 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | per admission copayment; 0.00; 0.00; 76.00; 0 | percent of allowed; 0.00; 20 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | lesser of per diem or percent; 250.00; 0.00; 0.00; 20 | lesser of per diem or percent; 1191.00; 25 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | per admission copayment; 0.00; 0.00; 201.00; 0 | percent of allowed; 0.00; 25 |

Amounts are US dollars; percents apply to the amount the stay is cost-shared on.

## Hypothetical stays (amount cost-shared on shown after the other insurer's payment)

| Tier and facility | Covered days | Amount cost-shared on | Liability |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, network | 4 | 2000.00 | the lesser of 1000.00 and 400.00: 400.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, non-network | 2 | 3000.00 | the lesser of 2382.00 and 750.00 (25 percent): 750.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, non-network | 3 | 900.00 | 25 percent: 225.00 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, network | 6 | 3000.00 | 201.00 |
| any tier | 0 | any | 0.00 |
